columnPool.hint: This station is served by Merseyrail.

columnPool.label: Route: Northern Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Northern Line route
columnPool.hint: The Merseyrail line running north-south through central Liverpool, splitting into three branches at the top: Southport, Ormskirk and the reopened Headbolt Lane - not to be confused with London's Underground line of the same name.

columnPool.label: Route: Wirral Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Wirral Line route
columnPool.hint: The Merseyrail loop under the Mersey linking Liverpool to the Wirral Peninsula, with branches to Chester, Ellesmere Port, New Brighton and West Kirby.

columnPool.label: Route: Cumbrian Coast Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Cumbrian Coast Line route
columnPool.hint: The long coastal route around the Cumbrian peninsula from Carlisle via Whitehaven and Barrow-in-Furness to Lancaster, skirting the Lake District's western edge.

columnPool.label: Route: Furness Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Furness Line route
columnPool.hint: The section of the Cumbrian coastal route around the Furness peninsula through Barrow-in-Furness - part of the wider Cumbrian Coast Line.

columnPool.label: Route: Liverpool to Manchester Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Liverpool to Manchester Line route
columnPool.hint: The historic route between the two cities via Newton-le-Willows and Patricroft - opened in 1830 as the world's first inter-city passenger railway.

columnPool.label: Route: City Line (Merseyside)
columnPool.display: Is part of the City Line (Merseyside) route
columnPool.hint: The wider commuter network branded City Line by Merseytravel, covering routes from Liverpool towards Manchester, Wigan, Warrington, Chester and Blackpool - unlike the Northern and Wirral lines, not operated by Merseyrail itself.

columnPool.label: Route: Fylde Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Fylde Line route
columnPool.hint: The coastal branch south from Blackpool via Ansdell & Fairhaven and Moss Side towards Preston - serves the Fylde coast resort towns.

columnPool.label: Route: South Fylde Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the South Fylde Line route
columnPool.hint: The coastal branch south from Blackpool via Ansdell & Fairhaven and Moss Side towards Preston - also simply called the Fylde Line.

columnPool.value: Liverpool to Manchester Line via Warrington Central
columnPool.label: Route: Liverpool to Manchester Line via Warrington Central
columnPool.display: Is part of the Liverpool to Manchester Line via Warrington Central route
columnPool.hint: The alternative, more southerly route between the two cities via Warrington Central and Irlam, distinct from the more direct Liverpool-Manchester main line via Newton-le-Willows.

columnPool.label: Route: Ormskirk Branch Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Ormskirk Branch Line route
columnPool.hint: The northern section of the old Liverpool-Preston main line, now the outer end of Merseyrail's Northern Line branch from Liverpool through Aintree to Ormskirk.
